laws.rule: Climbing to Hallasan's summit (Baengnokdam) needs an advance booking on the official Hallasan reservation system for the Seongpanak and Gwaneumsa trails; daily quotas are 1,000 on Seongpanak and 500 on Gwaneumsa.
laws.heading: 한라산탐방 예약시스템 (Hallasan trail reservation)

laws.rule: Camping and cooking in Hallasan National Park are allowed only at campsites in the Gwaneumsa district. Follow designated trails, and do not damage plants or insects or excavate soil.

layers.authority: Jeju Special Self-Governing Province, Hallasan National Park Management Office
layers.process: For Hallasan's summit stretches on the Seongpanak and Gwaneumsa trails, the park requires an online trail reservation. Its April 2025 notice says reservations open at 9 am on the first business day of the preceding month, for up to four people per reservation; it also lists limits on repeat bookings. Other named routes, including Eorimok and Yeongsil, are outside that reservation system. Confirm trail conditions and the latest process with the park before travelling.

layers.authority: Jeju Special Self-Governing Province, Hallasan National Park Management Office
layers.process: Hallasan visits are generally day trips. Entry and descent checkpoints have season-dependent cut-off times, and access can be restricted when heavy-rain, typhoon or heavy-snow warnings are issued. The park website displays two different seasonal cut-off tables; confirm the current times for your exact trail directly with the park.
